author: Turkiotib
quote: 13 years of waiting and so many delays, and this is what we get? A bunch of glitches, terrible driving, and way too much realism. Why tf do I have to refuel and stash my ****? Cars take so much damage and can even stop working just like a real car would. It just makes driving **** lighting **** too. There’s   this dark border around the screen, specially when driving, that makes everything look dim even in bright daylight. Sometimes you can barely see what’s going **** first hour of the story was good, but after that, it just got boring and **** if you get busted, you lose all the cash you’re carrying. So you have to spend time depositing it, then withdraw it whenever you need it. How is any of this supposed to be fun? I wanted to enjoy the game, but all this unnecessary realism and boredom made me quit this **** game.
